[SWS_DM_00414] Check supported DataIdentifier on active security level
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04275, RS_Diag_04227
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), a requested DataIden-
tifier shall be considered as supported on active security level if and only if
the DataIdentifier is supported according to [SWS_DM_00409] and the
Diagnos-
ticDataByIdentifier
.
accessPermission
references by its
DiagnosticAc-
cessPermission.securityLevel
the active security level in the DM.
⌋
